image_path.description: Path to the original image or the only available local visual source.

label_id.description: Stable label identifier used in pipeline JSONL output.

expected_sn.description: Ground-truth SN expected from barcode decoding.

barcode_present.description: True when an SN barcode is visible in the image.

accepted_quality.description: True only when the SN barcode is large enough, not clipped, not severely blurred, and has usable quiet zones.

label_crop.description: Optional path to the full label crop.

sn_path.description: Optional path to the detector-produced SN crop.

original_image_path.description: Optional explicit original image path when image_path is a crop.
